summary: community.routeros deprecates support for EOL Ansible versions. Its next major release drops Ansible 2.9, ansible-base 2.10 and ansible-core 2.11 through 2.14.
questions: Which versions will the next routeros collection release drop?

answer_card.title: community.routeros drops EOL Ansible versions
answer_card.answer_md: The next major community.routeros release drops Ansible 2.9, ansible-base 2.10 and ansible-core 2.11 through 2.14.
